name: ihris-dak
title: iHRIS health workforce DAK (draft data dictionary)
description: A WHO SMART Guidelines Digital Adaptation Kit (L2) data dictionary for health workforce information, derived mechanically from the iHRIS 4.3.3 data model. It is a knowledge asset built ON the described sources: derived, not authored, until a person authors the columns the source cannot answer.

canonicalBase._comment: NOT http://ihris.org/fhir: that is the iHRIS 5 IG's canonical and not ours to mint under. Owner to confirm.

assets.title: iHRIS health workforce DAK
assets.description: What was derived, how, and what still needs a person.

directories.readOnlyBasis: Generated by src/tools/build_dak.py; author descriptions in an overlay, never here (see README).
directories.description: One ihris-dak-data-dictionary/v1 sheet per iHRIS record form class, with WHO data-dictionary columns and provenance.
smart-base CoreDataElement instances: one logicalmodel per sheet, one valueset per iHRIS list used as input options.

FHIR R4 CodeSystem and ValueSet JSON for every DAK value set and every list its codes point at. Default records become a complete CodeSystem included by the ValueSet. Sample-data records become content=example CodeSystems that no ValueSet includes.
